Select a Human Validation Sample with Exact Inclusion Probabilities & IPW Weights

Source: R/sampling.R
select_validation_sample.Rd

Draws a reproducible human-validation subset from a corpus of LLM-coded texts using simple random, subgroup-stratified (proportional, equal-per-stratum for DPF power, or Neyman-optimal), score-quantile stratified, or cluster-stratified sampling. Returns exact inclusion probabilities \(\pi_i \in (0, 1]\) and Horvitz-Thompson inverse-probability weights \(w_i = 1 / \pi_i\) ready to pass directly into weighted ppi_mean() or ppi_lm() (active / IPW-PPI).

Usage

select_validation_sample(
  data,
  n = NULL,
  strategy = c("simple", "stratified", "neyman", "quantile", "cluster"),
  strata_col = NULL,
  score_col = NULL,
  cluster_col = NULL,
  allocation = c("proportional", "equal", "neyman"),
  n_quantiles = 4L,
  n_clusters = NULL,
  min_per_stratum = 2L,
  seed = NULL
)

Arguments

data

A data.frame (or llm_coded_data) representing the full population/corpus of units to sample from.

n

Target total number of units to select for human validation. For strategy = "cluster", used to determine the number of clusters if n_clusters is NULL.

strategy

Sampling design:

  • "simple": simple random sampling without replacement (SRSWOR).

  • "stratified": stratified sampling across strata_col using allocation.

  • "neyman": shorthand for Neyman-optimal allocation (n_h proportional to N_h * SD_h) using score_col (and strata_col, or quantile bins of score_col if strata_col is NULL).

  • "quantile": stratifies units into n_quantiles bins of score_col (covering distribution tails evenly).

  • "cluster": whole-cluster sampling over cluster_col.

strata_col

Name of the categorical stratification column (required for strategy = "stratified", optional for "neyman").

score_col

Name of a numeric proxy/LLM score column used to estimate stratum SDs for Neyman allocation or to form quantile strata.

cluster_col

Name of the cluster identifier column (required for strategy = "cluster").

allocation

Stratum allocation rule for "stratified" or "quantile": "proportional" (default), "equal" (maximizes power for subgroup DPF tests), or "neyman" (minimizes overall variance).

n_quantiles

Integer number of quantile strata for strategy = "quantile" (or "neyman" without strata_col). Default 4L.

n_clusters

Optional integer number of whole clusters to select when strategy = "cluster". Overrides n if supplied.

min_per_stratum

Minimum units selected per stratum (capped by stratum size). Default 2L.

seed

Optional integer random seed. Uses local RNG state restoration so global .Random.seed is never mutated.

Value

An S3 object of class "llm_validation_sample" containing:

  • selected_idx: sorted integer vector of selected row indices.

  • selected: logical indicator vector of length nrow(data).

  • inclusion_prob: numeric vector of exact positive inclusion probabilities \(\pi_i\).

  • weights: numeric vector of Horvitz-Thompson weights \(w_i = 1 / \pi_i\).

  • data: tibble copy of data augmented with is_validation, inclusion_prob, and sampling_weight.

  • stratum_summary: tibble summarizing population size, selected count, inclusion probability, and weight per stratum.

  • strategy, allocation, n_target, n_selected, n_population.

Examples

data(ema_coded)
agg <- aggregate_scores(ema_coded, score_col = "llm_score")
vs <- select_validation_sample(
  agg, n = 40, strategy = "stratified",
  strata_col = "group", allocation = "equal", seed = 42
)
vs
#> 
#> ── Validation Sample Plan (stratified / equal) 
#> Selected 40 of 120 units (33.3%) | Weight range: [2.90, 3.10]
#> # A tibble: 2 × 6
#>   stratum n_pop n_selected inclusion_prob weight stratum_sd
#>   <chr>   <int>      <int>          <dbl>  <dbl>      <dbl>
#> 1 group_a    58         20          0.345    2.9         NA
#> 2 group_b    62         20          0.323    3.1         NA
